game.name: Kung Fu Panda 2 (USA)
game.desc: The action game Kung Fu Panda 2 is an adaptation of the movie of the same name for Xbox 360. This particular version uses Kinect to let you slip into the shoes of Po, the famous noodle and kung fu loving panda. The motion-recognition accessory allows you to mimic the blows Po delivers to his enemies in your living room.
